stages.name: shrink_mechanism
stages.claim: at one discrepancy the update is a stay bump at zero or a move; a fit with one arm lands between them

stages.name: shrink_naive
stages.claim: averaged over stays and moves, the updates trace the kernel shrunk by about pi

stages.name: shrink_model
stages.claim: weighting by the gate's responsibilities splits them into a retention arm at mu_0 and an influence arm on the true kernel

stages.name: bc_mechanism
stages.claim: if people far away are more likely to keep their opinion, the stays depend on distance

stages.name: bc_naive
stages.claim: a linear kernel then looks like bounded confidence

stages.name: bc_model
stages.claim: weighted by the responsibilities, the moves sit on the linear kernel again
